record.paper_title: Answer to Some Open Problems and Global Bifurcation for an Overdetermined Problem
record.context_brief: Local minimality of bifurcating extremal domains
record.original_question: Let s → (w_s, T_s) be the local smooth bifurcation family from Theorem 1.1, where for each small s the modified cylinder Ω_s = {(x, t) ∈ R^n × R : |x| < 1 + s cos(2π t / T_s) + s w_s(2π t / T_s)} carries a positive T_s-periodic solution of the overdetermined eigenvalue problem Δu + λu = 0 in Ω_s, u = 0 on ∂Ω_s, and ⟨∇u, ν⟩ = const on ∂Ω_s. When Ω_s is viewed as a domain in R^n × R/T_sZ, is Ω_s a local minimizer of the first Dirichlet eigenvalue functional Ω → λ_1(Ω)?

evidence.quote: for each s ∈ (−ε, ε), (1.2) has a positive Ts-periodic solution us ∈ C2,α(Ωs ) on the modified cylinder Ωs = {(x, t) ∈ Rn × R : |x| < 1 + s cos(2π t/Ts) + sws(2π t/Ts)}.
Open Problem 1. Are the extremal domains Ωs in Rn ×R/TsZ (local) minima for the functional Ω → λ1(Ω)?
Note that Ωs may or may not be local minima for the functional Ω → λ1(Ω). Although we offer clarification for solving Open Problem 1, it remains open.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix an integer $n\ge 2$. Consider the overdetermined eigenvalue problem
$$\Delta u + \lambda u = 0 \text{ in } \Omega,\qquad u = 0 \text{ on } \partial\Omega,\qquad \langle \nabla u,\nu\rangle = \text{const on } \partial\Omega,$$
where $\nu$ is the outward unit normal. The straight cylinder $\Omega_0 = \{(x,t)\in\mathbb{R}^n\times\mathbb{R}:|x|<1\}$ admits the radial first Dirichlet eigenfunction, which trivially satisfies the overdetermined condition.

Assume there exists a smooth one-parameter bifurcation branch $s\mapsto (w_s,T_s)$, defined for $s$ in a neighborhood of $0$, of nontrivial periodic perturbations of $\Omega_0$, where $w_s:\mathbb{R}/2\pi\mathbb{Z}\to\mathbb{R}$ is a smooth function with $w_0\equiv 0$ and $T_s>0$ with $T_0$ equal to the bifurcation period, such that the modified cylinder
$$\Omega_s = \Bigl\{(x,t)\in\mathbb{R}^n\times\mathbb{R}\,:\, |x| < 1 + s\cos\!\bigl(2\pi t/T_s\bigr) + s\,w_s\!\bigl(2\pi t/T_s\bigr)\Bigr\}$$
carries a positive $T_s$-periodic $C^{2,\alpha}$ solution $u_s$ of the overdetermined problem above for some eigenvalue $\lambda_s>0$.

Viewed as a bounded domain in $\mathbb{R}^n\times(\mathbb{R}/T_s\mathbb{Z})$, is $\Omega_s$, for all sufficiently small $s\ne 0$, a local minimizer of the first Dirichlet eigenvalue functional $\Omega\mapsto \lambda_1(\Omega)$ among domains of the same volume on the flat manifold $\mathbb{R}^n\times(\mathbb{R}/T_s\mathbb{Z})$?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is explicitly stated as an open problem in the source itself, with the authors noting that, despite providing clarifications, the question of whether the bifurcating extremal cylinders $\Omega_s$ are local minimizers of $\lambda_1$ remains open. No subsequent resolution was identified.

status_evidence.snippet: Note that Ωs may or may not be local minima for the functional Ω → λ1(Ω). Although we offer clarification for solving Open Problem 1, it remains open.
